# Accelerate

<!-- generated:header (isim/tools/coverage-summary.py; do not edit by hand) -->
<!-- /generated:header -->

**Area:** [Imaging, photos & ML](../COVERAGE.md#ml) · **Apple:** [Accelerate](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/accelerate) · **Issues:** [`area:ml`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Aml)

## How isim implements it

- **Approach:** *adapted*: isim's own C implementation of vecLib (`isim/frameworks/Accelerate`): BLAS and LAPACK
  from one single/double template (`linalg_t.h`), vDSP from another (`vdsp_t.h`, `vdsp.c`), vForce over libm
  (`vforce.c`). No host library is needed (no OpenBLAS, LAPACKE or FFTW on the host): the code runs inside the app
  like Apple's, with Apple's argument orders, packing and scaling. It favours exactness over speed: BLAS is plain
  loops (no blocking or SIMD), LAPACK's QR is Householder and its eigensolver Jacobi, FFTs are mixed-radix
  Cooley-Tukey in double for any length.
- **Swift:** the overlay (`isim/swift/overlays/Accelerate`) adds `vDSP` and `vForce` with their Float and Double
  overloads (generated by `isim/tools/gen-accelerate-swift.py`), `AccelerateBuffer` / `AccelerateMutableBuffer`,
  `vDSP.FFT`, `vDSP.DFT` and `vDSP.DiscreteFourierTransform`.
- **Objective-C / C interface:** Apple's headers, `isim/sdk-src/Frameworks/Accelerate` (`Accelerate.h`, `cblas.h`,
  `clapack.h`, `vDSP.h`, `vForce.h`, `vecLibTypes.h`); the Swift API imports the same C functions.
- **Versus Apple's Simulator:** results agree to rounding (sums are accumulated in double); performance is far
  below Apple's tuned kernels.

## API

| API / feature | Status | iOS | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| BLAS (`cblas.h`): level 1 (`dot`, `nrm2`, `asum`, `i?amax`, `swap`, `copy`, `axpy`, `scal`, `rot`, `sdsdot`, `dsdot`), level 2 (`gemv`, `ger`, `symv`, `trmv`, `trsv`), level 3 (`gemm`, `symm`, `syrk`, `trmm`, `trsm`), `s` and `d`, row- and column-major | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: isim's C; negative increments as the reference BLAS; complex BLAS (`c`, `z`) is not there yet; tested (AccelerateCTest, AccelerateTest, test_accelerate) |
| LAPACK (`clapack.h`): `?getrf`, `?getrs`, `?gesv`, `?getri`, `?potrf`, `?potrs`, `?posv`, `?gels`, `?syev`, `s` and `d` | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted: the common drivers, Fortran calling conventions, `info` as LAPACK's (singular and non-positive-definite pivots); the rest of LAPACK (SVD, `geev`, banded, complex) is not there yet; the new LAPACK interface (`ACCELERATE_NEW_LAPACK`) neither; tested (AccelerateCTest) |
| vDSP C functions: arithmetic (`vadd`, `vsub`, `vmul`, `vdiv`, `vsadd`, `vsmul`, `vsdiv`, `svdiv`, `vsmsa`, `vma`, `vam`, `vsma`, `vneg`, `vabs`, `vsq`, `vssq`, `vmax`, `vmin`, `vclip`, `vthr`, `vlim`, `vclr`, `vfill`, `vramp`, `vgen`, `vrvrs`, `vsort`, `vlint`, `vintb`), reductions (`sve`, `svesq`, `svemg`, `meanv`, `meamgv`, `measqv`, `rmsqv`, `maxv`, `minv`, `maxmgv`, `minmgv`, `maxvi`, `minvi`, `dotpr`, `distancesq`), `mmul`, `mtrans`, `conv`, windows (`hann_window`, `hamm_window`, `blkman_window`), complex vectors (`ctoz`, `ztoc`, `zvadd`, `zvsub`, `zvmul`, `zvabs`, `zvmags`, `zvphas`, `zvconj`), conversions (`vspdp`, `vdpsp`, `vflt*`, `vfix*`, `vfixr*`, `vfixu*`, `vfixru*`); single and `D` double | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: isim's C with Apple's strides and argument orders (`vsub` / `vdiv` take B first, `conv` correlates or convolves with a negative filter stride); integer conversions saturate; tested (AccelerateCTest) |
| FFTs: `vDSP_create_fftsetup[D]`, `vDSP_destroy_fftsetup[D]`, `vDSP_fft_zip[D]`, `vDSP_fft_zop[D]`, `vDSP_fft_zrip[D]`, `vDSP_fft_zrop[D]` | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted: radix 2 setups (radix 3 and 5 setups return NULL), complex transforms unscaled, real transforms with Apple's even/odd packing (twice the DFT, the Nyquist bin in `imagp[0]`, a round trip of 2n); the 2D (`fft2d_*`) and multiple-signal (`fftm_*`) forms are not there yet; tested (AccelerateCTest) |
| DFTs: `vDSP_DFT_zop_CreateSetup[D]`, `vDSP_DFT_zrop_CreateSetup[D]`, `vDSP_DFT_Execute[D]`, `vDSP_DFT_DestroySetup[D]` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: lengths f × 2ⁿ with f ∈ {1, 3, 5, 15} (others return NULL), complex and real (packed) transforms; the interleaved setups are not there yet; tested (AccelerateCTest) |
| vForce (`vForce.h`): `vvsin` … `vvcbrt` (trigonometric, hyperbolic, `sinpi` / `cospi` / `tanpi`, exponentials and logarithms, `sqrt`, `rsqrt`, `rec`, `fabs`, `floor`, `ceil`, `nint`, `int`), two-argument `vvatan2`, `vvpow`, `vvdiv`, `vvfmod`, `vvremainder`, `vvcopysign`, `vvnextafter`, `vvpows`, `vvsincos`; `f` and double | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: libm per element, Apple's (result, y, x, count) order; tested (AccelerateCTest) |
| Swift: `AccelerateBuffer`, `AccelerateMutableBuffer` (arrays, slices, buffer pointers) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted; tested (AccelerateTest) |
| Swift: `vDSP` arithmetic (`add`, `subtract`, `multiply`, `divide`, `absolute`, `negative`, `square`, `signedSquare`, `maximum` / `minimum` of two vectors, `clip`, `fill`, `clear`, `ramp`, `reverse`, `sort`, `linearInterpolate`), reductions (`sum`, `sumOfSquares`, `sumOfMagnitudes`, `mean`, `meanSquare`, `meanMagnitude`, `rootMeanSquare`, `maximum`, `minimum`, `maximumMagnitude`, `minimumMagnitude`, `indexOfMaximum`, `indexOfMinimum`, `dot`, `distanceSquared`), `convolve`, `correlate`, `convertElements`, `integerToFloatingPoint`, `floatingPointToInteger`, `window(ofType:usingSequence:count:isHalfWindow:)` | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted: Float and Double overloads, returning arrays or writing `result:`; vDSP's compound operations (`add(multiplication:…)`, …), complex-vector, biquad and `vDSP.Stride` APIs are not there yet; tested (AccelerateTest, HelloAccelerate) |
| Swift: `vDSP.FFT` (`forward`, `inverse`, `transform`), `vDSP.DFT`, `vDSP.DiscreteFourierTransform` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: over the C FFT and DFT; tested (AccelerateTest, HelloAccelerate) |
| Swift: `vForce` (`sqrt`, `rsqrt`, `reciprocal`, `exp`, `exp2`, `expm1`, `log`, `log2`, `log10`, `logb`, `log1p`, trigonometric and hyperbolic functions, `sinPi` / `cosPi` / `tanPi`, `floor`, `ceil`, `trunc`, `nearestInteger`, `pow(bases:exponents:)`, `remainder`, `truncatingRemainder`, `copysign(magnitudes:signs:)`, `sincos`) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted; tested (AccelerateTest, HelloAccelerate) |
| BNNS (the layer API and `BNNSGraph`) | ❌ | ≤17 | not there yet (#543); BNNSGraph runs models compiled by Apple's tools |
| vImage (#371), Sparse Solvers, Quadrature (#543) | ❌ | ≤17 | not there yet |
